snippet.title: Death By Scrolling - Publishing Announcement
snippet.description:
MicroProse is proud to announce we are publishing Death By Scrolling, a chaotic rogue-like vertically scrolling RPG from legendary game designer Ron Gilbert (Monkey Island, Maniac Mansion). Revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live 2025, the game takes players into the bizarre depths of Purgatory™—now under new management.

Race upward through endless levels, battle quirky underworld monsters, dodge deadly traps, and stay ahead of the relentless Grim Reaper. Your goal: collect 10,000 gold to pay the Ferryman and finally escape the afterlife.

Wishlist Death By Scrolling on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773590/Death_By_Scrolling/
